question: The perimeter of a square is 52 m. Its area (in m²) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of the square = Perimeter ÷ 4

Side = 52 ÷ 4 = 13 m

Area = Side² = 13 × 13 = 169 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 169 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of the square = 52 m

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a square = 4 × a

Area of a square = a² (where a is the side of the square)

 
 a = 13 m
 a = 13 m
 a = 13 m
 a = 13 m
 Area = ?
 P = 52 m

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × a = 52

⇒ a = 52 ÷ 4

⇒ a = 13 m

⇒ Area = a²

⇒ Area = 13 × 13

⇒ Area = 169 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 169 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Diagonal of a Square

The length of the diagonal of a square with side a is given by d = a√2.

Area in terms of Diagonal

If the diagonal (d) is known, the area of the square can be directly calculated as Area = d² ÷ 2.

Incircle and Circumcircle of a Square

Radius of incircle = a ÷ 2 | Radius of circumcircle = a ÷ √2.
